text:
maya_success: Quick heads-up — leadership review Wed 9am PT. We need an 8–10 slide deck + a 3-min live demo for top renewal-risk accounts (Nimble & Triton). Can we lock slide owners and demo lead by EOD Friday? @emma_csm @devon_se

emma_csm: I can own the Nimble slide (health + mitigation plan). Will add metrics and churn signals.

devon_se: I'll do the demo flow and runbook. Need environment access & sample prompts. Can someone add me to Triton staging? @jeff_platform

jeff_platform: Adding devon_se to Triton staging now. Calbot will send invite. Also, quick perf note — latest model quantization changed prefix latency, will include a note.

calbot: event created — "Leadership Review • Wed 9am PT". Invites sent to attendees.

alex_pm: For slides, keep 1 slide for 'Renewal risk heatmap', 1 for 'Activation trends', 1 for 'Mitigation asks'. I'll draft heatmap.

maya_success: Nice. Emma + Alex coordinate on heatmap numbers. Devon — demo should show failover fallback (streaming -> cached). Keep the demo script > 2 bullets.

emma_csm: Uploading Nimble slide draft: https://drive.redwood/reports/nimble-slide-draft (placeholder). Feedback welcome. @maya_success

devon_se: Demo script draft:
```
1) Login -> show account config
2) Trigger heavy prompt (simulate spike)
3) Show fallback to cached model +112ms saved
4) Show rollback to stable model
```
Need someone to run step 2 with sample data.

jeff_platform: I will run step 2 in staging at 3pm Tue. devon_se — can you pair with me?

maya_success: Action items: 1) Emma upload final Nimble slide by Thu EOD 2) Alex finalizes heatmap by Thu noon 3) Devon+Jeff dry-run Tue 3pm 4) I'll prep exec talking points. Anyone else? :memo:

emma_csm: noted. Also collecting customer quotes for the 'risk' slide. Pinged CS ops to surface latest support tickets.

devon_se: adding checklist in the thread:
- [ ] Demo credentials verified
- [ ] Sample prompts ready
- [ ] Staging perf baseline
- [ ] Fallback validated

ops-bot: Support tickets for Nimble flagged: #5782, #5790, #5803 — exported to deck.

maya_success: Thanks all. If no blockers, we'll lock the deck Friday morning. I'll post a final pre-read by Sun night.

emma_csm: one blocker — legal asked for redaction on one customer quote. I'll update and post the redacted quote by Thu.

devon_se: all set from my side.

maya_success: locking thread — will post pre-read when ready. :lock:
